name: Commerce & growth analytics
why: Use commerce context to explain revenue, conversion and customer behavior.
day: A merchant campaign underperformed. Work out why and recommend the next change.
skills: SQL joins, funnel metrics, Excel pivots; evaluate the reason for a result.

name: Consumer & customer insights
why: Connect behavior, research and business decisions.
day: Combine interviews, a survey and sales data into a customer recommendation.
skills: Survey design, descriptive statistics, Excel; quantitative research may demand more.

name: Product operations & management
why: Use real founder examples to show customer understanding and prioritization.
day: Choose the most important customer problem and define a measurable feature.
skills: Product case writing, usage metrics, stakeholder communication; technical depth varies.

name: Business & revenue operations
why: Turn process knowledge and analysis into better business execution.
day: Find why a sales or service process is slow, then test a fix.
skills: Excel, basic SQL, process mapping and structured business reasoning.

name: Demand, pricing & category
why: Connect inventory and merchandising experience with analytical planning.
day: Explain a stockout or promotion result and build a better forecast.
skills: Excel forecasting, SQL, uncertainty; avoid advanced optimization roles initially.

name: Commercial finance & FP&A
why: Test whether business performance and financial planning are interesting.
day: Explain a budget variance and forecast the next quarter.
skills: Financial statements, accounting basics, Excel modeling; a real domain-learning cost.

name: BI & product data analytics
why: Develop SQL and data-quality skills on real business questions.
day: Clean data, define a metric, produce a chart and explain a decision.
skills: SQL joins and windows, one BI tool, Python fundamentals, basic inference.
